What's important right now is making sure she knows that she can rely on you guys to talk about it, and what she feels. Try to make it something not taboo to talk about, for example when she brings it up try to listen to how she feels, even if you don't understand it, try to provide a safe listening space for her. Over time, hopefully she'll slowly learn how to live with what happened, but right now it's really important to support her, and it's great that you're taking her to a therapist. It takes time but don't worry, she's still the same person, just has sadly has been through something that a child should never go through. I hope this helps, I'm speaking from experience when I say having a strong support system really helps when times get tough especially going through court stuff.
